title: Assistant Manager Finance
how_to_apply: Email your CV and last salary slip to hr@alnoor.example with the subject: AM Finance.
description: Own the monthly closing, sales tax and income tax filings, bank reconciliation and internal audit follow-up. You need at least two years of hands-on ERP experience (SAP or Oracle). You will report to the Finance Manager. The office is in Gulberg III, Lahore, and Saturday is a half day.

title: Lab Technician (BPS-09)
qualification: F.Sc Pre-Medical or Diploma in Lab Technology
how_to_apply: Submit the application form with attested documents at the District Health Authority office, Sukkur, during office hours.
description: Run routine lab tests at the basic health unit and the TB clinic, keep the sample register up to date and report results to the medical officer. This is a two-year contract post and can be extended on performance.

title: Junior Software Engineer (Remote)
qualification: BS Computer Science or equivalent portfolio
how_to_apply: Send your CV and a GitHub link to jobs@northline.example. Shortlisted candidates get a 45-minute interview and a small take-home task.
description: Build and maintain REST APIs in Python, write tests and help ship weekly releases. You will work with one senior engineer and a product manager. This is a fully remote role open to candidates living in Pakistan, with core hours from 10am to 6pm PKT.
